answer: Reputation is weighted by an exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life, so past endorsements lose influence and sustained honest service is needed to build durable trust. In the EigenTrust matrix factorization, a freshly spawned Sybil identity has almost no trusted incoming support and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot manufacture credible evidence from a closed cluster. Like a quill charting a nebula voyage, each new claim still needs a reliable path to established peers before consensus will accept it.
